description: This file implements the IpcLoop class, which manages an IPC communication loop using a dedicated thread, including creation, destruction, and message processing for inter-process communication in the Rialto server manager.

classes.name: IpcLoop
classes.description: Manages an IPC communication loop with a dedicated thread, handling message processing, connection management, and creation of blocking closures and RPC controllers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of IpcLoop, establishing IPC channel and starting the thread.

methods.name: IpcLoop
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC channel, controller factory, client reference, and starting the IPC thread.

methods.name: ~IpcLoop
methods.description: Destructor that signals thread termination, disconnects the IPC channel, joins the thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ipcThread
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread, processing IPC messages and handling disconnection.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Returns the underlying IPC channel object.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure object, choosing between polling or semaphore-based depending on the calling thread.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller for sending RPC requests.
